name: Pho Trang Kim
summary: A Đồng Văn bowl. Dân Việt describes thick, chewy noodles, a light sweet broth, and firm chicken, made in a manual way.
howToEat: Eat it as a bowl of phở. No clock is given.
seoTitle: Pho Trang Kim in Dong Van — thick noodles
seoDescription: Phở Tráng Kìm is a Đồng Văn bowl of thick, chewy noodles, a light sweet broth, and firm chicken. It is not the breakfast phở.
